source: Saved node-metrics.jsonl (/proc/stat, /proc/meminfo every ~5 s) and process-samples.txt (ps every ~10 s) from claim runs 36832069153, 36836204912 and 36840043405 (attempt 1). No tests were run.

definitions.t: Seconds from the first claim submission (burst start). Negative values are before the burst.
definitions.host.busy: Host CPU busy percent over the previous ~5 s sample, all 32 logical CPUs, excluding idle and iowait. Includes every process: relay validators, collators, load generator and CI tools.
definitions.host.maxCore: Busiest single logical CPU in that sample, percent.
definitions.host.usedGiB: MemTotal minus MemAvailable, GiB. Includes every process and the page cache that the kernel cannot reclaim.
definitions.processRssGiB: Resident memory of the two People collators and the load generator (ps RSS). Collator processes are matched to names by start order (substrate_process_start_time_seconds); the load generator is the Node.js process named MainThread.
definitions.collatorAverageCores: Average CPU cores used in a window, from ps lifetime %CPU and the process start time. Windows: beforeFixtures (network running, nothing submitted), fixtures (fixture preparation), burst (first submission to last receipt).
